data.question_quote: Just firstly on the fixed-income result and very strong relative to peers. So any reason why there might be episodic revenues in that or any additional seasonality compared to your peers? And if you could help us think about the breakdown between credit, securitized products, rates and FX? Any colour you can share would be helpful.
